description: There's a Story in All of Us is ETAT's annual exhibition celebrating the creativity, voices and lived experiences of people at our charity. Discover artworks inspired by memory, identity and storytelling, plus the premiere of our silent film, a comedy about a grand art heist set in Pimlico. See how we use our community hall to foster creativity, connection and belonging. Thursday 17 Sept, 12–8pm

factsheet.heading: About ETAT at the Thamesbank Centre
paragraphs: The Thamesbank Centre was built at the same time as the creation of the charity Encouragement Through the Arts and Talking (ETAT). Since it's opening in 2010, the Thamesbank Centre has been the home of ETAT, a place where people come together every Tuesday and Thursday throughout the year. ETAT uses the hall as a creative community space where adults can take part in visual arts, creative writing, gentle exercise, social activities and shared meals, helping to reduce loneliness and build lasting friendships.

This exhibition offers a rare opportunity to see the Thamesbank Centre in use as a vibrant creative hub. Alongside the exhibition, visitors can explore how art, conversation and community can reshape an everyday hall into a place of belonging. The event also includes the premiere of a participant-made silent film, created and filmed in Pimlico, celebrating the people, places and humour of the local area.
